RESIDUAL_PAIR_FLOOR_CERTIFICATE: For every outside pair, residual S2 is at least I(C,D)-I(A,C,D)-I(B,C,D); the omitted four-event term is nonnegative. The finite type-pair census minimizes this floor over all legal shared/A-only/B-only/outside cell intersections.
RESIDUAL_S3_POINTWISE_CERTIFICATE: For each same-mass state, residual multiplicity m<=K gives C(m,3)<=(K-2)*C(m,2)/3 when K>=3; otherwise S3=0. The frontier carries K on each S2 interval.
RESIDUAL_UNION_POINTWISE_CERTIFICATE: For 1<=m<=K, 1<=m-2*C(m,2)/K. The good-type union objective uses the minimum residual S2 and maximum multiplicity from the same outside-pair-mass state. Other anchor type classes use their own within-class pair floors and are combined by subadditivity.
